heroHeading: We love to paint. Let us take on your project.
heroLede: We paint the inside and outside of homes. We come look, give you a price in writing, and do the job right.
servicesLede: Inside, outside, and decks and fences. We take our time and do each one well.
aboutLine: Nick Losch owns Whitetail Painting Solutions. He picked up his first brush at 12, working alongside his uncles, and never put it down. He just keeps on rolling.
aboutBody: We believe everyone should be proud of their home.
aboutPoints: A written price before we start
Floors and furniture covered while we work
Insured, and happy to show you

faq.question: What does painting cost?
faq.answer: It depends on the size of the job and how much the walls need fixing. That's why we come look first. Then you get one price in writing. It won't change unless you ask for more work.

faq.question: How long will it take?
faq.answer: One room usually takes a day or two. A whole floor can take most of a week. We'll tell you how many days when we give you the price.

faq.question: Do I need to move my furniture?
faq.answer: No. We move what we can and cover the rest. If something is heavy or special to you, just tell us.

faq.question: What paint do you use?
faq.answer: Good paint from brands you know. We pick the right kind for each room. If you have a brand you like, we'll use it.

faq.question: Where do you work?
faq.answer: Juniata County and the rest of Central Pennsylvania, about an hour from home. If you're a little farther, ask anyway.
